podcast.body: An instrumental track from the "Ghosts I–IV" album, released under a Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial Share-A-Like License. A Dutch beatmaker named YoungKio remixed this track and sold it online for $30. Montero Hill (Lil Nas X) purchased this remix, wrote lyrics over it, and released it independently as "Old Town Road" on December 3, 2018. Due to the license violation (commercial use), Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross were given official songwriting credits and shared in the song's chart records, including its 19 weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100. "A Dutch beatmaker named Young Kiel took up Trent on his offer. He messed with one of the tracks called 34 Ghosts 4 and put the results up for sale online for $30."
